sentences: For `image_sample`, take the UV derivatives before branching on the T# format, then sample the matching float, UINT or SINT view with those gradients.
In `ps_sample_implicit_sint` a 128×128 signed texture minifies onto 64×64 pixels.
Clamping the sampler to level 0 returned four color quadrants; allowing level 1 returned cyan.
All four signed D16 channels matched at every pixel on RTX 5080 and gfx1036.
